name: Blogent Connector
author: Blogent.tools

sections.description:
Blogent Connector connects WordPress to the Blogent SaaS platform. Blogent prepares the content and schedules publication. A Blogent account is required.

  • Publish new articles and update existing posts while preserving their URLs and publication dates.
  • Sync site languages and categories automatically, including WPML, Polylang and WP Multilang.
  • Use cover images from category folders, the Media Library or Blogent.
  • Support article images, YouTube videos and shortcodes.
  • Assign an existing WordPress author when selected in Blogent.
  • Save SEO metadata for Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO.

External Service and Privacy

After you connect the site, Blogent can request its languages, categories, authors and blog articles, and send new or updated articles through the token-protected webhook. WordPress stores received content, metadata and images locally. Webhook errors appear in the plugin’s log. Images supplied by URL are downloaded from that URL into the Media Library.

Service website: https://blogent.tools/
WordPress setup guide: https://blogent.tools/integration#wordpress
Terms: https://blogent.tools/terms
Privacy policy: https://blogent.tools/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New, or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/smmix-ai-seo-blog/. Activate Blogent Connector.
  2. Open Settings > Blogent Connector, choose the blog category and optionally select image folders or photos. Save.
  3. Copy the Webhook URL into Blogent, select WordPress and click Load from website.
  4. Run Test connection in Blogent to check both creating and updating a post.
sections.faq:
Can I update articles already on my site?

Yes. Blogent can update existing posts while keeping their IDs, URLs, publication dates, authors and featured images.

Can I use my own photos?

Yes. Choose a folder from the site root for each image category, or select individual photos. The image category can differ from the publication category. Folder selection uses images directly inside that folder. Clear the folder selection to switch to individual photos.

Do I have to enter language codes or category slugs?

No. Blogent loads these from WordPress and the active multilingual plugin.

Where are connection errors shown?

Open Settings > Blogent Connector > Logs.
sections.changelog:
4.0

  • Publish new articles and update existing posts with Content Engine V2.
  • Load languages, authors and categories automatically.
  • Choose image folders per category, independently of the publication category.
  • Preserve article images, YouTube videos and shortcodes.
  • Simplify settings and add Ukrainian translations.
  • Support WordPress 4.7+ and remove the InnoDB requirement.

2.9

  • Prevent duplicate posts when an article URL is already in use.
